tagline: Four-chord progression templates with MIDI file export
description: Shows a four-chord progression built from one of eight genre templates in C major and saves it as a .mid file. It does not produce MIDI in real time: the processor passes incoming MIDI through unchanged, and nothing is saved with the project. It is built as a MIDI effect (IS_MIDI_EFFECT TRUE), so Ableton Live will not load it.

features.name: Genre Templates
features.description: Pop, Rock, Jazz, Blues, EDM, Emotional, Happy and Sad map to fixed Roman-numeral progressions; a parsing bug currently turns every IV chord into a V.

features.name: Triads in C Major
features.description: Each chord is a root-position major or minor triad built on the C major scale; there is no key selector.

features.name: MIDI File Export
features.description: Writes the four chords one bar each on channel 1 at velocity 100, with a 120 BPM tempo marker.
